# Beyond the Cosmic Horizon
## Scripture
"But you, Lord, sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations. You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come." - Psalm 102:12-13

## Reflection
As we gaze out into the vast expanse of the night sky, we're reminded of the mysteries that lie beyond our cosmic horizon. The universe stretches out before us like an endless canvas, painted with the vibrant colors of stars, galaxies, and nebulas. Yet, amidst this grandeur, we find comfort in the fact that our God is not a distant, detached observer, but an intimately involved and compassionate Lord. Psalm 102:12-13 reminds us that God's reign is eternal, and His love endures through all generations. Just as the universe operates according to His sovereign plan, our lives are also guided by His wise and loving purposes.

## Prayer
Dear Heavenly Father, as we marvel at the wonders of your creation, we're humbled by the realization of your infinite power and wisdom. Help us to trust in your sovereign plan, even when the mysteries of the universe seem beyond our understanding. May we find comfort in your enduring love and compassion, and may our hearts be filled with wonder and awe as we contemplate the vast expanse of your creation. May your glory be our guiding star, leading us through the complexities of life and into the depths of your eternal love. Amen.
